parole.significato: a wooden, somewhat bird-shaped target, often ornamented with bright plumes, used in archery competitions
parole.testo: A parallel form of papagaai (“parrot”), by popular etymology confused with etymology 1, but actually from Middle Dutch papagoie, papegoie, from Arabic بَبَّغَاء (babbaḡāʔ) and Persian بپغا (bapġâ), of uncertain origin.
